title: Handle restored child reopening after its root execution has ended
outcome: Handle restored child reopening after its root execution has ended
acceptance: Restored child reopening beneath a cancelled or superseded root, including an ended prior root execution, succeeds under documented lifecycle rules or returns a typed refusal without creating an active aggregate beneath a terminal root.
Behavioral tests cover both ordinary and checked-successor reopen, generation uniqueness, refusal atomicity and retained-identity retry.

completion.summary: Refuse restored child reopening beneath terminal ancestors before creating an execution generation.
